description.value: An HL7 administrative unit that owns artifacts in the FHIR specification.
The type of committee. Values are 'Work Group', 'Management Group', 'Council' and 'Governance Group'
The status of committee. Values are 'active' and 'inactive'

Designation of a concept's state. Normally this property is not provided unless its the value is retired. Note, concepts are usually only retired if entered in error. Retirement status should not be interpreted to mean that the committee itself was retired.
Whether the group is included in the JIRA Spec Artefact file for workgroups
The key stored in the JIRA project. This should not change or be removed even if a work group is renamed or dissolved.
The code used for the work group on the HL7 website.
The display name for the work group. This can be update if the work group changes its name.
This is set to true for groups that can no longer be assigned responsibility for tracker items, but which may have had responsibility for historical items
The email address used for the work group on the HL7 website.
